speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The world is in transition from the post-Cold War order to a more uncertain era, marked by disruptions to global trade, the weaponisation of economic tools, rising risks of conflicts, weakening multilateralism, sharper major power rivalry and rapid technological change.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: These shifts pose serious challenges for Singapore, whose survival and prosperity depend on free trade, access to global supply chains, and our role as a business and logistics hub.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Singapore’s foreign policy must adapt swiftly to these realities.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Our strength lies in our reputation for stability and reliability, and in our national unity and resilience.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Constructive cooperation with our immediate neighbours is vital.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: These projects will enhance connectivity and strengthen economic and people-to-people ties.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: ASEAN remains a cornerstone of our foreign policy.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will also expand ASEAN’s network of partnerships, ensure key international players have a stake in the region’s success and work towards an open, inclusive and ASEAN-centred region.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: MFA will strengthen ties with both the United States and China – important partners across many domains.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Through our new Development Partnerships Directorate, MFA will strengthen the Singapore Cooperation Programme to share our experience with others and coordinate Singapore’s development partnerships in areas where we have relevant strengths.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Our growing network of free trade agreements are avenues to work with like-minded partners.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We are exploring partnerships between the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership, the European Union and ASEAN to preserve open flows of trade and investment and build economic resilience.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We are also expanding collaboration in Digital Economy and Green Economy to create opportunities for Singaporeans in forward-looking areas.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will proactively support effective rules-based multilateralism at the United Nations (UN) and the World Trade Organization, while playing a constructive role in plurilateral arrangements.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: By advancing a positive agenda in areas like artificial intelligence, climate change, and pandemic preparedness, MFA will continue to demonstrate our commitment to being a responsible steward of the global commons.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Despite the challenges of global governance, patient and skilful diplomacy can produce consensus outcomes.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The safety of Singaporeans abroad remains a priority.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: MFA will strengthen consular capabilities, expand diplomatic networks and enhance emergency response coordination, including through digital tools like the eRegister platform.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: National unity is essential in navigating a more contested geopolitical climate and withstanding external pressures.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: MFA will continue engaging Singaporeans on our core foreign policy considerations and Singapore’s role on the global stage, building the domestic support needed to act in our long-term national interests.
